sentences.en: OFFICIAL: Hello?
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 你好？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh, hello. wanted to enquire about hiring a room in the Village Hall, for the evening of September the first
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，你好。我想咨询一下，能否在9月1日晚上租用村礼堂的一个房间。

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: Let me just see Yes, we have both rooms available that evening
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 我查一下……好的，那天晚上两个房间都有空。

sentences.en: There's our Main Hall - that's got seating for 200 people
sentences.zh: 我们有主礼堂——可容纳200人就座。

sentences.en: Or there's the Charlton Room
sentences.zh: 或者还有查尔顿室……

sentences.en: Example
sentences.zh: 示例

sentences.en: WOMAN: Sorry?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 对不起？

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: The Charlton Room • C-H-A-R L-T-O-N
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 查尔顿室——C-H-A-R-L-T-O-N。

sentences.en: That's got seating for up to one hundred
sentences.zh: 该房间最多可容纳100人就座。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Well, we're organising a dinner to raise money for charity, and we're hoping for at least 150 people, so I think we'll go for the Main Hall
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是这样，我们正在组织一场慈善筹款晚宴，预计至少有150人参加，所以我想我们选主礼堂。

sentences.en: How much would that cost?
sentences.zh: 租金是多少？

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: Let's see
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 我看看。

sentences.en: You wanted it for the evening of September 1st?
sentences.zh: 您要租的是9月1日晚上，对吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, that's a Saturday
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 对，那天是星期六。

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: So from six pm to midnight that'd be £115 - that's the weekend price, it's £75 on weekdays
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 所以从晚上6点到午夜，租金为115英镑——这是周末价格；工作日则是75英镑。

sentences.en: WOMAN: That's all right
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 这样可以。

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: And I have to tell you there's also a deposit of £250, which is returnable of course as long as there's no damage
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 我还得告诉您，另外还需缴纳250英镑的押金，当然，只要没有损坏，这笔钱会全额退还。

sentences.en: But we do insist that this is paid in cash, we don't take cards for that
sentences.zh: 但我们坚持要求押金必须以现金支付，不接受银行卡支付。

sentences.en: You can pay the actual rent of the room however you like though - cash, credit card, cheque
sentences.zh: 不过，房间的实际租金您可以任意选择支付方式——现金、信用卡或支票均可。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh, well I suppose that's OK
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，那应该没问题。

sentences.en: So does the charge include use of tables and chairs and so on?
sentences.zh: 那么，这个费用是否包括桌椅等设施的使用？

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: Oh, yes
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: WOMAN: And what about parking?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那停车呢？

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: Yeah, that's all included
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 是的，停车也全部包含在内。

sentences.en: The only thing that isn't included is ... you said you were organising a dinner?
sentences.zh: 唯一不包含的项目是……您刚才说要办一场晚宴，对吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yeah
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 对。

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: Well, you'll have to pay extra for the kitchen if you want to use that
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 那么，如果您想使用厨房，就得额外付费。

sentences.en: It's £25
sentences.zh: 费用是25英镑。

sentences.en: It's got very good facilities good quality cookers and fridges and SO on
sentences.zh: 厨房设施非常完善，配有高品质的炉灶、冰箱等等。

sentences.en: WOMAN: OK, well I suppose that's all right
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的，那应该也没问题。

sentences.en: We can cover the cost in our entry charges
sentences.zh: 我们可以把这笔费用摊入入场费中。

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: Right
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 好的。

sentences.en: So 'll a make a note of that
sentences.zh: 那我就记下这些了。

sentences.en: Now there are just one or two things you need to think about before the event
sentences.zh: 现在，在活动举办前，您还需要考虑一两件事。

sentences.en: For example, you'll have to see about getting a licence if you're planning to have any music during the meal
sentences.zh: 例如，如果您计划在用餐期间播放音乐，就必须申请相关许可证。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh, really?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，真的吗？

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: It's quite straightforward, I'll give you the details later on
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 办理起来相当简单，稍后我会把详细信息给您。

sentences.en: And about a week or ten days before your event you'll need to contact the caretaker, that's Mr Evans, to make the arrangements for entry - he'll sort that out with you
sentences.zh: 另外，在您活动开始前大约一周或十天左右，您需要联系管理员埃文斯先生，就入场安排事宜与他协调——他会和您具体落实。

sentences.en: WOMAN: And do give him the payment as well?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那付款也一并交给他吗？

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: No, you do that directly with me
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 不，您直接付给我就行。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: Now is there anything need to know about what happens during the event?
sentences.zh: 那么，关于活动期间会发生什么，还有哪些需要了解的事项吗？

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: Well, as you'll be aware, of course the building is no smoking throughout
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 嗯，您当然知道，整栋大楼全面禁烟。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Of course
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 当然。

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: Now, are you having a band?
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 那么，你们会请一支乐队吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的。

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: Well, they'll have a lot of equipment, so rather than using the front door they should park their van round the back and use the stage door there
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 嗯，他们设备很多，因此他们不应从前门进入，而应将厢式货车停在后方，并从后方的舞台入口进入。

sentences.en: You can open that from inside but don't forget to lock it at the end
sentences.zh: 您可从内部打开那扇门，但结束时别忘了将其锁上。

sentences.en: WOMAN: OK
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: And talking of bands, I'm sure I don't need to tell you this, but you must make sure that no one fiddles about with the black box by the fire door - that's a system that cuts in when the volume reaches a certain level
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 说到乐队，我想我无需提醒您这一点，但您必须确保没人触碰消防门旁那个黑色盒子——那是一套音量达到特定阈值时自动启动的系统。

sentences.en: It's a legal requirement
sentences.zh: 这是法律要求。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Sure
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 明白。

sentences.en: Anyway, we want people to be able to talk to one another so we don't want anything too loud
sentences.zh: 总之，我们希望人们能彼此交谈，因此不希望现场声音过大。

sentences.en: Oh, that reminds me, we'll be having speeches - are there any - microphones available?
sentences.zh: 哦，这倒提醒我了，我们会有演讲环节——有麦克风可用吗？

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: Yeah
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 有。

sentences.en: Just let the caretaker know, he'll get those for you
sentences.zh: 只要告知管理员一声，他会为您准备好。

sentences.en: Right, now when the event is over we do ask that the premises are left in good condition
sentences.zh: 好的，活动结束后，我们确实要求场地恢复良好状态。

sentences.en: So there's a locked cupboard and you'll be informed of the code you need to open that
sentences.zh: 因此，那里有一个上锁的储物柜，您将获知开启所需的密码。

sentences.en: It's got all the cleaning equipment, brushes and detergent and so on
sentences.zh: 柜内备有全部清洁用具，包括刷子、清洁剂等。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: So what do we need to do after everyone's gone?
sentences.zh: 那么，所有人离开后我们需要做些什么呢？

sentences.en: Sweep the floors L suppose?
sentences.zh: 我想，大概要清扫一下地板吧？

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: Well, actually they have to be washed, not just swept
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 实际上，地板必须清洗，而不仅仅是扫除。

sentences.en: Then you'll be provided with black plastic bags, so all the rubbish must be collected up and left outside the door
sentences.zh: 随后，我们会提供黑色塑料垃圾袋，因此所有垃圾须集中收集并放置于门外。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Of course
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 当然。

sentences.en: We'll make sure everything's left tidy
sentences.zh: 我们会确保一切收拾得井井有条。

sentences.en: Oh, and I forgot to ask, I presume we can have decorations in the room?
sentences.zh: 哦，我还忘了问一件事：我猜我们可以在房间里布置装饰品吧？

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: Yes, but you must take them down afterwards
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 可以，但活动结束后必须拆除。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Sure
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 明白。

sentences.en: OFFICIAL: And the chairs and tables should be stacked up neatly at the back of the room
sentences.zh: OFFICIAL: 此外，椅子和桌子应整齐堆叠在房间后方。

sentences.en: WOMAN: I'll make sure I've got a few people to help me
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我会确保安排几个人来协助我。
